info.description: The Applicant Onboarding v2 APIs are used to manage the process of transfering the applicant data into HCM systems, including reading the API metadata. ADP Workforce Now enables client practitioners to add new employees using the New Hire Template. The Applicant Onboard V2 Application Programming Interface (API) posts an applicant as an In-Progress and completed hire into ADP Workforce Now. This enables a practitioner to complete the hire by logging into ADP Workforce Now and add the new hire data. For more information refer Applicant Onboard V2 API Guide for ADP Workforce Now.
